overview_description.description: Biostate AI is a company focused on providing AI-powered solutions for the life sciences and healthcare industries. The company develops data-driven tools to optimize medical research, drug discovery, and clinical trials. By leveraging artificial intelligence and machine learning, Biostate AI aims to streamline complex processes and improve decision-making. Their products include platforms for predictive analytics, data integration, and patient recruitment, which help organizations enhance efficiency and accuracy in medical and clinical operations. Through their innovations, Biostate AI supports the advancement of healthcare through smarter technology applications.

product.name: N-Act AI
product.description: A multi-omics intelligence model that analyzes DNA, RNA, and protein data to identify disease signatures, predict risks and treatment responses, and produce interpretable clinical insights.

product.name: K-Dense AI
product.description: An autonomous scientific research platform that uses multi-agent AI to analyze biological data, generate hypotheses, conduct literature reviews, and produce publication-ready research outputs.

product.description: A blood-based transcriptomic precision-medicine panel supporting multiple sclerosis screening, MS-versus-NMO differential diagnosis, and RRMS-to-SPMS subtyping from one blood draw.

product.name: OcupathIF
product.description: A desktop application for no-code analysis of multi-channel fluorescence microscopy images, including cell segmentation, phenotyping, spatial analysis, visualization, and CSV export.

product.name: Wet-Lab RNA and DNA Sequencing
product.description: RNA and DNA sequencing services and technologies for generating high-fidelity biological data at reduced sample and processing requirements for precision medicine and genomic screening.
